description: Passive prompt injection scanner daemon. Reads tool descriptions from mcp_server_registry via ws_query. For each server: scan description and any fetched tool schema (GET {url}/tools timeout=5s) for injection patterns: (1) hidden XML/HTML tags in descriptions, (2) system prompt override attempts: ignore previous, disregard, act as, (3) invisible unicode characters (zero-width space U+200B, soft hyphen U+00AD), (4) base64-encoded instruction blobs in description fields, (5) nested tool calls attempting to invoke other MCPs. Risk scoring: 1+ injection pattern = trust_score -= 30, severity=CRITICAL. ws_write mcp_threat_associations {server_id, threat_type=prompt_injection, evidence=pattern_found+line, severity=CRITICAL, reported_at=now}. ws_write mcp_signal_scores tool_description_safety signal update. Poll 14400s. Heartbeat.
